query: SELECT Trim( hl.region ) AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.id) AS population_count FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala hp JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON hp.id = hl.id WHERE hp.is_in_population = true AND hp.snapshot = (SELECT MAX(snapshot) FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala) AND Trim( hl.region ) != '' AND hl.region IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Trim( hl.region ) ORDER BY population_count DESC LIMIT 3
raw_question: أعلى ثلاث مناطق في عدد السكان
